blocks.text: 正文范围：第二章§1–§3，以及§4性质2–6和相关证明，至教材第43页性质7之前。保持“陈述 → 数学记号 → 证明”；不加入数值例题或重复解释。
前半部分目标35分钟；新增性质2–6目标15分钟。所有时间均包含口述和板书，合计50分钟。每节标题下给出目标时间。实际时长仍需试讲校准。
新增部分沿用教材证明顺序。性质2、3先把行列式中的项按固定一行分组；性质4通过项的配对相消证明；性质5、6依次由前面的性质推出。
We begin with the determinant of order two.
Definition. The determinant of a two-by-two array is defined by the following formula.
板书：写二阶行列式及展开式。sub 表示下标；这里竖线表示行列式。
Let me write the formula on the board. The vertical bars denote a determinant. We read the right-hand side as: a sub one one times a sub two two, minus a sub one two times a sub two one.
Next, we define permutations, inversions, and parity.
Definition 1. A permutation of order n is an arrangement of 1 to n, with each number used exactly once. The arrangement 1, 2, ..., n is the natural order.
指向排列：这里连写表示顺序，不是相乘。
We write a permutation as j sub one, j sub two, through j sub n. The braces show that these entries are exactly the numbers from one to n.
Definition 2. An inversion is a pair in which the larger entry comes first. The inversion number is the number of these pairs.
读法：tau 读 /taʊ/；# 表示个数；括号后的冒号表示满足后面的条件。
We denote the inversion number by tau. Here, the hash symbol means the number of elements in the set. We count pairs of positions p and q, where p is less than q and j sub p is greater than j sub q.
Definition 3. A permutation is even or odd according as its inversion number is even or odd.
≡ 读 is congruent to；mod 2 读 modulo two。
We write this using congruence modulo two. A remainder of zero means even; a remainder of one means odd.
The natural order is therefore even. We use the same definitions for any n distinct natural numbers.
We now define a transposition.
Definition. A transposition exchanges two entries and fixes all other entries. It is adjacent when the two entries are next to each other.
板书：写出对换前后；箭头说明交换，不必逐字读省略号。
Here, s is the number of entries between j and k. The arrow shows that we exchange j and k. All the entries in between keep their positions.
The first theorem describes how a transposition changes parity.
Theorem 1. A transposition changes an even permutation into an odd permutation, and an odd permutation into an even permutation.
π 读 pi /paɪ/；π′ 读 pi prime。先指原排列，再指新排列。
Let pi denote the original permutation, and pi prime the new one. In this notation, tau of pi prime is congruent to tau of pi plus one, modulo two.
Proof

First, suppose j and k are adjacent. Every other entry is before both or after both. Its inversion pairs with j and k stay the same. Pairs containing neither entry also stay the same. Only the pair j, k changes.
Δτ 读 delta tau；分段公式按两个 if 句读。
Delta tau means the new inversion number minus the old one. It is minus one if j is greater than k, and plus one if j is less than k.
So an adjacent transposition changes the parity.
Now suppose s entries lie between j and k. The following adjacent transpositions exchange j and k and leave all other entries in place.

blocks.latex: \begin{aligned}\cdots j\,i_1\cdots i_s\,k\cdots&\xrightarrow{s+1}\cdots k\,j\,i_1\cdots i_s\cdots\\&\xrightarrow{s}\cdots k\,i_1\cdots i_s\,j\cdots.\end{aligned}

blocks.text: 板书：保留原书的两步变换；指箭头上的次数。
The numbers above the arrows count adjacent transpositions: s plus one first, then s more.
Each adjacent transposition changes parity. The number of transpositions is odd, so the final parity changes. This completes the proof.

title: Equal numbers of even and odd permutations

blocks.text: Next, we introduce a corollary of Theorem One.
Corollary. For n at least 2, there are equally many even and odd permutations of order n. Each number is n factorial divided by 2.
denotes 表示“表示、记作”；# 的读法已在定义2说明。
Here, s denotes the number of odd permutations, and t denotes the number of even permutations.
n! 读 n factorial；≥ 读 is greater than or equal to。
We read this as: s equals t equals n factorial divided by two, for n greater than or equal to two.
Proof

Let s be the number of odd permutations and t the number of even permutations. Swap the first two entries in each odd permutation. By Theorem One, each result is even. The results are distinct, since swapping again recovers the original permutation. Therefore, there are at least s even permutations.
Now start with the even permutations and do the same thing. We obtain t distinct odd permutations. Therefore, there are at least t odd permutations.
The two inequalities give s equals t. There are n factorial permutations in total, so each number is n factorial divided by two.
We now state Theorem Two.

Theorem 2. Every permutation can be changed into natural order by finitely many transpositions, and conversely. The number of transpositions is even for an even permutation and odd for an odd permutation.
接下来已有的英文句子读同余式；m 与逆序数奇偶性相同。
On the board, m denotes the number of transpositions. The arrow takes the permutation to natural order.
m is congruent to tau of pi modulo two.
Proof: existence
We use induction on n. For n equal to one, no transposition is needed. Assume every permutation of order n minus one can be sorted.
If the last entry is n, sort the first n minus one entries by the induction hypothesis. Leave n fixed.
If the last entry is not n, swap it with n. Then use the previous case. This completes the induction. Reversing the transpositions gives the reverse transformation.
j′ 读 j prime；带下标时如 j sub one prime。
The primes mark the entries after the transposition. They do not mean derivatives here.
Proof: parity
Each transposition changes parity. After m transpositions, we reach the natural order, whose inversion number is zero. Hence the original inversion number plus m is even.
The reverse sequence has the same length. This proves both directions.
We can now define the determinant of order n.

Definition 4. For entries in a number field P, the determinant is the sum of products choosing one entry from each row and each column. In increasing row order, a product has a plus sign for an even column permutation and a minus sign for an odd one.
板书：A 是矩阵，aᵢⱼ 是元素；n×n 读 n by n；aᵢⱼ∈P 读 a sub i j belongs to P。
Let A be an n by n matrix. We write a sub i j for the entry in row i and column j. Here, P is the number field from which we choose the entries. We read the membership symbol as belongs to.
板书：指 D、det A 和竖线行列式，说明三者是同一个数。
We denote its determinant by D, or det A. We read det A as the determinant of A.
完整读法：D equals the sum over all permutations j sub one through j sub n, of minus one raised to tau of that permutation, times a sub one, j sub one, through a sub n, j sub n。乘积中每个 a 有行、列两个指标。

Let me write the defining sum. D equals the sum over all column permutations. Each term is minus one raised to the inversion number of the column permutation, times the product of the selected entries.
The sum runs over all permutations of 1 to n. The first index is the row index; the second is the column index.

title: Triangular determinants
zh: 三角行列式结论及证明

blocks.text: We next state the triangular determinant result.

Definition. The main diagonal consists of the entries a sub i i. An array is upper triangular if all entries below its main diagonal are zero. It is diagonal if all entries off the main diagonal are zero.
> 读 is greater than；≠ 读 is not equal to。
In symbols, a sub i j equals zero when i is greater than j. For a diagonal matrix, it equals zero whenever i is not equal to j.
Result. An upper triangular determinant equals the product of its diagonal entries.
板书：指对角元素的乘积，不用逐项展开所有因子。
The right-hand side is a sub one one times a sub two two, and so on, times a sub n n.
Proof

Consider a term that is not zero. Its last-row entry must be a sub n n. Column n is now used. In row n minus one, we must therefore choose column n minus one. Continuing upwards forces every column index to equal its row index.
All other terms are zero. The diagonal term has the natural column order, so its sign is plus. If a diagonal entry is zero, this term is zero too. The formula still holds.
Corollary. A diagonal determinant is the product of its diagonal entries. If all diagonal entries are 1, its value is 1.
diag(d₁,…,dₙ) 可直接读 the diagonal matrix with entries d sub one through d sub n；Iₙ 读 I sub n。
Here, diag means the diagonal matrix with entries d sub one through d sub n. I sub n denotes the identity matrix of order n.
Proof
A diagonal array is upper triangular. Apply the result just proved.

title: Sign of a term in any order

blocks.text: Next, we state the sign rule for factors written in any order.
Result. For a product choosing one entry from each row and each column, its coefficient in the determinant is minus one to the sum of the row and column inversion numbers.

blocks.latex: a_{i_1j_1}\cdots a_{i_nj_n},\qquad i_1\cdots i_n,\ j_1\cdots j_n\text{ are permutations}

blocks.text: aᵢ₁ⱼ₁ 可读 a sub i sub one, j sub one；口述用 row … and column … 更清楚。
In each factor, the first index gives the row and the second gives the column. For example, the first factor is the entry in row i sub one and column j sub one.
指指数中的两个 τ：分别对应行指标排列和列指标排列。
We read the sign as: minus one raised to the sum of the two inversion numbers.
Proof
Swap factors until the row indices are in natural order. Theorem Two shows that this is possible. Changing the factor order does not change the product.
Each exchange of two factors gives one transposition of the row indices and one of the column indices. By Theorem One, both inversion numbers change parity. Their sum keeps the same parity.
The final row inversion number is zero. The sign is therefore the sign of the final column permutation, exactly as in the definition.
This proves the rule.

title: Column order and transpose
zh: 按列公式、转置性质及证明

blocks.text: This sign rule gives the formula in column order.
Result. In increasing column order, the sign of each term is determined by the row permutation.
板书：指 aᵢ₁₁ 到 aᵢₙₙ，列指标依次为1到n。
Here, the columns are in natural order, and the sum runs over all row permutations.
Proof
Write each product in increasing column order. This lists the same products once each. The column inversion number is zero, so the general sign rule gives this formula.
We now define the transpose and state Property One.
Definition. Transposing an array exchanges its rows and columns.
Aᵀ 读 A transpose；bᵢⱼ=aⱼᵢ 读 b sub i j equals a sub j i。
We denote the transpose of A by A transpose. Its entry in row i and column j is a sub j i.
Property 1. Transposing an array does not change its determinant.
指转置前后的两个行列式。
This says: the determinant of A transpose equals the determinant of A.
Proof
Write the determinant of B in column order. Replace each entry of B by the corresponding entry of A. The result is the row-order definition of the determinant of A.

blocks.latex: \begin{aligned}\det B&=\sum_{i_1\cdots i_n}(-1)^{\tau(i_1\cdots i_n)}b_{i_1 1}\cdots b_{i_n n}\\&=\sum_{i_1\cdots i_n}(-1)^{\tau(i_1\cdots i_n)}a_{1i_1}\cdots a_{ni_n}\\&=\det A.\end{aligned}

blocks.text: Definition. An array is lower triangular if all entries above its main diagonal are zero.
Corollary. A lower triangular determinant equals the product of its diagonal entries.
Proof
Its transpose is upper triangular and has the same diagonal entries. Apply Property One and the upper triangular formula. This completes the proof.

title: Scaling one row
zh: 新增 性质2及零行推论

blocks.text: We now continue with the determinant properties. We state them for rows. By Property One, they also hold for columns.
Property 2. Multiplying one row by a number k multiplies the determinant by k.
板书：写完整行列式，指出改变的第i行；不引入整行简写。
On the left, every entry in row i is multiplied by k. On the right, k is outside the determinant.
Proof
Fix row i. Each term contains exactly one entry from this row. Group the terms by this entry and factor it out.
区分小写 aᵢⱼ 与大写 Aᵢⱼ。后面紧接原稿对系数含义的说明。
We write the coefficients with a capital A. The first term is lowercase a sub i one times capital A sub i one.
Here A sub i j is the sum left after factoring out a sub i j from its group. It contains no entry from row i. So these coefficients stay the same when row i changes.
Using this expression, we get
Corollary. If all entries in one row are zero, the determinant is zero.
Proof
Set k equal to zero in Property Two.
Next, we state Property Three.
Property 3. If each entry in one row is a sum of two numbers, the determinant splits into two determinants. All other rows stay the same.
板书：其余各行照写；分别指左边的一行和右边对应的两行。
Let me write the three determinants. In the changed row, the entries are b sub j plus c sub j. On the right, we separate the b entries and the c entries.
Proof
Let this be row i. Use the same coefficients A sub i j, which do not depend on this row. Expand and separate the two sums.
This proves Property Three.
We now state Property Four.
Property 4. If two rows are equal, the determinant is zero.
板书：这是两行对应元素相等，i、k 是两个不同的行号。
In symbols, a sub i j equals a sub k j for every j from one to n. Here, i is not equal to k.
Proof
Suppose rows i and k are equal. By the definition, the determinant is

blocks.latex: \begin{vmatrix}a_{11}&a_{12}&\cdots&a_{1n}\\\vdots&\vdots&&\vdots\\a_{i1}&a_{i2}&\cdots&a_{in}\\\vdots&\vdots&&\vdots\\a_{k1}&a_{k2}&\cdots&a_{kn}\\\vdots&\vdots&&\vdots\\a_{n1}&a_{n2}&\cdots&a_{nn}\end{vmatrix}=\sum_{j_1\cdots j_n}(-1)^{\tau(j_1\cdots j_i\cdots j_k\cdots j_n)}a_{1j_1}\cdots a_{ij_i}\cdots a_{kj_k}\cdots a_{nj_n}

blocks.text: We show that all terms cancel in pairs. For each term, the following term also occurs:

blocks.latex: \begin{aligned}&(-1)^{\tau(j_1\cdots j_i\cdots j_k\cdots j_n)}a_{1j_1}\cdots a_{ij_i}\cdots a_{kj_k}\cdots a_{nj_n},\\&(-1)^{\tau(j_1\cdots j_k\cdots j_i\cdots j_n)}a_{1j_1}\cdots a_{ij_k}\cdots a_{kj_i}\cdots a_{nj_n}.\end{aligned}

blocks.text: aᵢⱼᵢ 可以说 the entry in row i and column j sub i；aₖⱼₖ 同理。
Compare the factors from rows i and k. In the second term, their column indices are exchanged.
Since the two rows are equal, we have
So the products are equal. The two column permutations differ by one transposition:

blocks.latex: j_1\cdots j_i\cdots j_k\cdots j_n,\qquad j_1\cdots j_k\cdots j_i\cdots j_n

blocks.text: Their signs are opposite, so these two terms cancel. Every term has a distinct partner, and exchanging again returns the original term. Thus all terms cancel in pairs.
Next, we obtain Property Five.
Property 5. If two rows are proportional, the determinant is zero.
指 aᵢ₁,…,aᵢₙ 与 kaᵢ₁,…,kaᵢₙ 两行。
In this determinant, each entry in one row is k times the corresponding entry in the other row.
Proof
By Property Two, take the common factor k out of one row. The two rows are then equal, so Property Four gives zero.

title: Adding a multiple of another row

blocks.text: Finally, we state Property Six.
Property 6. Adding a multiple of one row to another row does not change the determinant.
板书：指第i行的和，再指保持不变的第k行；i 与 k 不同。
On the left, the new entry in row i and column j is a sub i j plus c times a sub k j. Row k stays the same. The determinant on the right is the original one.
Proof
By Property Three, split row i into two parts. The second determinant has two proportional rows, so it is zero by Property Five.
This completes the proof.
